name: AlphaBetaTrackerQ16
adaptation: Scalar constant-velocity g-h prediction/correction at dt=1. Position, velocity and measurement use signed 32-bit raw values with 16 fractional bits. Per-sample unsigned gains have 15 fractional bits. Corrections floor independently; only the final state updates saturate. Ready/valid transaction framing and reset cancellation are explicit hardware adaptations. The task does not implement covariance estimation, vectorized filtering or variable elapsed time.
